facts.quote:
Evaluation and measurement are key capacities 
for effective AI governance but are critically 
underdeveloped
facts.summary: The preliminary scientific report identifies evaluation and measurement as underdeveloped governance capacities, requiring context-sensitive assessment of deployed systems, not models alone.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; assessment, not an adopted governance instrument

facts.quote:
A United Nations-based platform is also 
one promising option to host this dialogue 
on a continuous, universally inclusive basis, 
complementary to the venues above.
facts.summary: The Panel discusses a continuous, inclusive UN platform for developer-state-scientist dialogue as complementary to other venues; this passage proposes a function rather than granting enforcement powers.
facts.document_status: Preliminary scientific report; governance assessment and proposal

facts.quote:
Significant global capacity-building is required to ensure local communities can safely adapt and 
assess AI systems.
facts.summary: Open models offer adaptation and innovation opportunities but require local assessment capacity and safeguards against irreversible release and misuse.

facts.quote:
activities of the Panel and the 
Dialogue are limited to the non-military domain and do 
not refer to artificial intelligence for military purposes
facts.summary: The report explicitly identifies the Panel and Dialogue mandate under resolution79/325 as non-military; military AI and lethal autonomous weapons fall outside its present scope.
facts.document_status: Preliminary report citing an adopted General Assembly resolution

facts.quote:
General Assembly resolution 
79/325 explicitly provides for the issuance of 
thematic briefs in addition to the annual report.
facts.summary: The report describes thematic briefs as part of the mandate and planned follow-up work; intended briefs are not evidence of later publication.
facts.document_status: Preliminary report; mandate description and planned next steps
